name: Following Christ
overview: Following Christ involves a wholehearted commitment to deny oneself, take up the cross, and walk in His ways, as Jesus commands in Matthew 16:24. This path is illuminated by Christ, who is the light of the world, guiding believers away from darkness into the light of life (John 8:12). Salvation and eternal life come through faith in Christ alone, the only way to the Father (John 3:16; John 14:6), and this faith is expressed both inwardly in the heart and outwardly in confession (Romans 10:10). True discipleship means valuing Christ above all else, considering worldly gains as loss for His sake (Philippians 3:7).
